changes.newValue:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Add Electron host files and package scripts for desktop runtime.
2. Add deterministic Godot desktop export script that outputs to electron-dist/godot-web.
3. Add/ensure Web preset in scene/export_presets.cfg.
4. Validate npm install + desktop export + electron packaging commands.
5. Document commands in docs and update task notes/AC.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Add Electron host files and package scripts for desktop runtime.
2. Add deterministic Godot desktop export script that outputs to electron-dist/godot-web.
3. Add/ensure Web preset in scene/export_presets.cfg.
4. Validate npm install + desktop export + electron packaging commands.
5. Document commands in docs and update task notes/AC.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Add Electron host files and package scripts for desktop runtime.
2. Add deterministic Godot desktop export script that outputs to electron-dist/godot-web.
3. Add/ensure Web preset in scene/export_presets.cfg.
4. Validate npm install + desktop export + electron packaging commands.
5. Document commands in docs and update task notes/AC.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.

snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

- Validation:

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts
Workflow produces and releases macOS, Linux, and Windows Electron artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.title: Build Electron desktop app host for Godot game
snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts
Workflow produces and releases macOS, Linux, and Windows Electron artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

## Validation
- `npm install` succeeded (with escalated network).
- `npm run godot:export:desktop` succeeded and generated `electron-dist/godot-web/index.html`, `.js`, `.wasm`, `.pck`.
- `npm run electron:pack` succeeded and generated `dist/mac-arm64/PlanetHuntersDesktop.app`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.

snapshot.description: Create an Electron desktop target so users can run the Godot game in a Node.js/Electron runtime.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Electron app launches and loads the Godot game
Godot desktop export artifacts are generated/copied into Electron runtime path
Repo includes commands/docs to build and run desktop app
Electron desktop: bottom ButtonContainer remains visible and clickable after scene load
Git ignore excludes non-essential Electron build outputs
GitHub Action builds Electron desktop artifacts on push to main/electron-support
Workflow publishes a GitHub Release containing desktop artifacts
Workflow produces and releases macOS, Linux, and Windows Electron artifacts

snapshot.implementationPlan:
1. Update `.gitignore` with Electron artifact/cache patterns while keeping source files tracked.
2. Add `.github/workflows/electron_release.yml` triggered on push to `main` and `electron-support`.
3. In workflow: install deps, export Godot desktop web bundle, run `electron-builder` on matrix OS targets, collect artifacts.
4. Create release tag per run and upload artifacts to GitHub Release.
5. Validate workflow syntax locally and document assumptions in task notes.
snapshot.implementationNotes:
## Summary
- Added Electron host (`electron/main.js`, `electron/preload.js`) that serves Godot web export from local Node HTTP server.
- Added desktop export script: `scripts/export_godot_desktop.sh`.
- Added npm scripts: `godot:export:desktop`, `electron:dev`, `electron:pack`, `electron:dist`.
- Added Electron builder config in `package.json` and docs in `docs/ELECTRON_DESKTOP.md`.
- Added Godot `Web` export preset in `scene/export_presets.cfg`.

- Follow-up fix: SafeAreaUI now reapplies layout when ButtonContainer/TutorialPanel/FrancBalance nodes are added to tree.
